english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a hobby or leisure interest.

examples.jyutping: haang4 saan1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 hing3 ceoi3

english.note: For personal curiosity or hobbies, 興趣 is the all-purpose choice.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for liking or interest, especially in an activity, subject, or thing.
Use this for a subject or activity someone is keenly interested in, such as a hobby or personal interest.

examples.english: I have a lot of interest in photography.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 jing2 soeng2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

examples.english: I have a real fancy for hiking.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 haang4 saan1 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

examples.english: I have always had a lot of enthusiasm for photography.
examples.traditional: 我對攝影一直都好有興趣。
